answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch auctions slots; a bidder posts twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. No bidder hides in a nebula of shell bids, since each bid is deposit-backed. Resold slots sit on a mesa of records, so star clusters stand out, and a falcon-eyed reviewer can challenge them, burning the deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 wins and 100 deposits; an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted reward.
